name: shopping_assistant_api
description: A shopping assistant tool that generates product information and order confirmation details. The output contains two parts: 1. Product details (name, type, description, features, price, rating, etc.); 2. Order confirmation information (order ID, purchasing platform, date, amount, logistics information, etc.)

item_type.description: The category of the item, e.g., Electronics, Home Goods, Clothing

item_name.description: The name of the item, e.g., Smartphone, Insulated Mug, Jeans

item_features.description: List of item features, e.g., ['Wireless charging', 'Waterproof', 'Large capacity']
